title: C: Worker Pool (Simulated)
description: Simulate a worker pool where multiple workers pick up and execute tasks from a shared queue.

steps.title: Worker Pool Simulation
steps.description: Define a `Task` struct (id, description). Create a shared array of tasks. Write a `worker_run` function that takes tasks from the queue and prints 'Worker N processing: task description'. Simulate 3 workers processing 5 tasks in round-robin.
hints: Tasks stored in a global array with an index counter.
Each worker picks the next available task.
